WITH rating_avgs AS (
  SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS avg_rate_per_day
  FROM film
  WHERE replacement_cost >= 20.99
  GROUP BY rating
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_rate_per_day) AS overall_mean
  FROM rating_avgs
)
SELECT r.rating,
       r.avg_rate_per_day,
       r.avg_rate_per_day - o.overall_mean AS above_overall_mean
FROM rating_avgs r
CROSS JOIN overall o
WHERE r.avg_rate_per_day > o.overall_mean;
